items.description:
Business value
Field service work often happens in environments where network quality changes throughout the day. Technicians may move between connected, low-connectivity, intermittent, and offline conditions while still needing the mobile app to remain dependable.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Enhance mobile offline up-sync
items.description:
Business value
Technicians often complete work in the field while connectivity is limited or intermittent. When offline changes still need to sync, users and back-office teams can be uncertain whether work details, status updates, and other field changes have reached business systems.
Mobile offline up-sync is being enhanced so changes captured in the field can continue syncing more reliably. This helps frontline users gain confidence that completed work will be submitted without repeatedly chec

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Modernize the mobile offline foundation
items.description:
Business value
Field service organizations often depend on mobile offline so technicians can keep working when connectivity is limited or unavailable. As offline profiles grow larger and apps include more related data, first sync, resource loading, and repeated sync work can affect technician productivity and confidence in the mobile experience.
Power Apps mobile offline is being updated with a more native foundation for data access and sync orchestration. This foundation is intended to improve

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
items.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
items.description: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Personal message reminders for chat and channels
items.description: Teams now lets you set and manage reminders directly on chat and channel messages, helping you keep track of important items. Create, update, complete, and delete reminders, track them in a dedicated Reminders view, and receive timely notifications when they become due. Reminders are private to each user and include message context, making them easy to revisit and act on when needed.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
items.description: Self-service diagnostics help identify common issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. The experience highlights potential misconfigurations and provides simple guidance to help customers understand and resolve them. This brings basic troubleshooting into the product and helps eDiscovery admins overcome common challenges.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Engage - Improved shared messages end-user experience
items.description: Improving the shared conversation experience in Viva Engage to so it's easier for users to discover, read, and participate.

items.description: Agents and supervisors can use Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile to quickly understand and follow up on customer conversations. items.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. items.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

items.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

items.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

The system considers factors like employee availability, approved time off, past scheduling patterns, and scheduling rules (e.g., max hours, rest time); and generates a draft schedule that you can review and adjust before publishing.
